title: Color Contrast Checker
reason: The owner-bound CLI implements the WCAG 2.2 relative-luminance color-pair calculation and compares full-precision ratios against text and non-text thresholds; it does not claim page conformance or APCA support.

unsupported_behavior.reason: APCA is beta and polarity-sensitive; it is not implemented here and is not a WCAG 3 conformance method.

title: CSS Gradient Generator
reason: The owner-bound CLI validates kind-specific geometry, bounded CSS colors, and kind-appropriate stop positions as data; it preserves source order, rejects injection, and serializes linear, radial, and conic gradients. Two-position stops, transition hints, explicit radial radii, calc(), and interpolation controls remain disclosed limitations rather than inferred browser fidelity.
